Allow the PocketNode agent to operate your device on your behalf: tap the screen, swipe, type text, and go back.
Actions are performed only after you enable the "Allow agent to control device" switch inside the app. It is off by default.
Once enabled, anything that can trigger the agent gains the same gesture capability as you do, including tapping payment buttons, sending messages, and deleting data. Enable it only if you understand the risk, and turn it off when not in use.
Let the agent tap and operate the screen for you
Manufacturers restrict background activity by default to keep apps
from running freely. PocketNode\'s downloads, model loading, and
relay service all depend on staying resident in the background.
Whitelisted. The system will not restrict background work.
Not whitelisted. Downloads and inference may freeze when the screen is off.
Allow the app to restore itself after a reboot
Follows the system by default. Choose one to pin it.
The app cannot grant these permissions itself. Please adjust them in Settings.
Why this cannot be one tap
For security, Android does not let an app grant itself these permissions. Otherwise any installed program could make itself unkillable, and power management would be meaningless.

Autostart has no unified API. Each vendor implements its own, so the app tries them one by one. This page will route you to the right screen where possible, but the final switch is still yours to flip.
No model loaded. Go to Models and tap Load into memory.
No model loaded. Download one in Models then tap Load into memory.
Models are stored in private app storage
Uninstalling the app deletes them too. To keep them in /storage/emulated/0/%1$s instead, grant the permission first.
Delete this model to free space
The model file for "%1$s" will be deleted, freeing %2$s. You will need to download it again to use it.
The model file for "%1$s" will be deleted. You will need to import it again to use it.
Go to Chat to start using it

No model is loaded. The service can start, but requests will return model_not_loaded. Load one on the Models page first.

Endpoint URL for the client Base URL

Any OpenAI-compatible client can connect. Fill in two fields:
 · Base URL: the address above

The model name can be anything; the endpoint only serves the model loaded locally.
⚠️ This is a LAN endpoint without encryption. The other side must be on the same WiFi.
Do not forward this port to the internet. There is no rate limiting and no request size limit.
Exposing it is equivalent to handing your device to someone else.
I enabled the switch but nothing happens
Allow API key holders to control this device
You still need to grant accessibility access in system settings, otherwise the switch has no effect.
If the switch on the authorization page cannot be toggled or keeps reverting, note that since Android 13

apps installed outside an app store are not allowed to enable accessibility services by default. This is an anti-fraud measure. Go to Settings → Apps → PocketNode → three-dot menu → Allow restricted settings first. The system does not mention this step, so it is easy to mistake for a broken switch.
Once enabled, the agent acts as you. Its reach is identical to yours, including payments, sending messages, and deleting data.
Device control is not exposed through the relay by default. To open it you must enable the remote switch below, which resets to off on every launch.
Turn it off when not in use.
Remote control is open. Anyone holding the API key can read your screen and operate the UI.

If you forward the port to the internet while the relay is plain HTTP, the key has no protection in transit and can be captured by carriers or public WiFi. Use a TLS tunnel such as Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel instead of port forwarding.
Once enabled, anyone holding the API key can
· read everything on your screen (SMS codes, chats, bank balances)
· tap any button (including confirming transfers or deleting data)
If you forward the port to the internet while the relay is plain HTTP, the key can be intercepted in transit.
Protections in place: actions are throttled to at least 600ms apart, remote control auto-closes after 10 minutes idle, and everything is logged. None of these withstand a leaked key.
Key value (you may write your own)
Enter the same key as before and configured clients keep working after a reinstall.
Smallest tier. For low-end devices or quick verification. Answer quality is limited, but it runs.
The balanced choice for Chinese conversation, trading answer quality against size. A good everyday default.
Chain-of-thought distilled model. Clearly stronger at math and logic than peers, but slower to generate. Not recommended for casual chat.
Largest tier, aimed at flagship devices. Requires 12GB+ RAM and a Snapdragon 8-class processor.
